result.instructions: Tools for Plumsail Documents, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Generate a contract PDF from our Word template for customer 4411 and return the link."; "Which fields does the offer template need? List the tokens of that process."; "How many documents are left on our Plumsail plan this month?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Plumsail Documents data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run plumsail_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run plumsail_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run plumsail_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. plumsail_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: plumsail_get_profile
tools.title: Get account profile and licence
tools.description: Return the Plumsail account profile: name, email, team, licence status, plan type, remaining credits and expiry date. Use it to check the connection and the plan limits.

tools.name: plumsail_list_processes
tools.title: List document processes
tools.description: List the document generation processes configured in the account, with their ids and settings as Plumsail returns them. Use the id with plumsail_get_process_tokens.

tools.name: plumsail_get_process_tokens
tools.title: Get process template tokens
tools.description: List the tokens (placeholders) used in a process's template: label, type and key. Use the keys as the fields of the data you pass to a generate call.

tools.name: plumsail_generate_document
tools.title: Generate document from template
tools.description: Fill a DOCX or XLSX template with data and return a link to the result file. Each call uses one document from the account's monthly plan. The output type is the vendor default. Results must finish within 30 seconds; large files may fail.

templateUrl.description: Public https URL of the DOCX or XLSX template.

data.description: Values for the template tokens, as a JSON object (keys from plumsail_get_process_tokens).

engine.description: Template engine. Omit to use the vendor default; see the Plumsail engine docs.

locale.description: Locale for dates and numbers, for example en-US or de-DE.

timezone.description: IANA time zone for the date token, for example Europe/Prague.

tools.name: plumsail_convert_to_pdf
tools.title: Convert Office file to PDF
tools.description: Convert a DOCX, XLSX or PPTX file to PDF and return a link to the PDF. Each call uses one document from the account's monthly plan. Results must finish within 30 seconds.

sourceUrl.description: Public https URL of the DOCX, XLSX or PPTX file.
